sources.name: get
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; cd "$D" && printf '['; s=''; for f in $(ls 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(brown|pink|white|deep|rain)\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.s$' | head -5); do printf '%s"%s"' "$s" "$f"; s=,; done; printf ']'

sources.name: put
sources.cmd: D={{state}}/widgets/{{widget}}/data; mkdir -p "$D"; case "$HATCH_ARG" in *.s) ;; *) echo "not a noise file" >&2; exit 1;; esac; printf '%s' "$HATCH_ARG" | grep -qE '^(brown|pink|white|deep|rain)\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.s$' || { echo "bad noise file" >&2; exit 1; }; rm -f "$D"/*.s; : > "$D/$HATCH_ARG"; printf '{}'
